question: On 14 May 2024, the Commission guaranteed that an investigation would be opened into its financial support for associations linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, including Islamic Relief Worldwide. 1.
Could the Commission confirm if the German national agency responsible for managing the subsidies paid to these associations has actually launched an investigation?
In future, can we count on having automatic verification procedures to avoid situations where EU citizens are funding Islamism?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (25.2.

2025) Following allegations regarding an Erasmus+ project1 coordinated by Islamic Relief Germany in 2023, the German National Agency in charge of vocational education and training and adult education conducted thorough checks with the relevant German authorities and concluded that there were no relevant legal findings that would have justified to terminate the project in question.

The Commission is politically committed and legally bound to ensure that no one receives EU funding if they are involved in criminal or unethical practices, terrorism-related offences or in other activities incompatible with EU values. The award of funds is conditional to the absence of any exclusion grounds as set out in Article 138 of Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/25092.

The recent Financial Regulation recast3 from September 2024 introduced an explicit ground under the Early Detection and Exclusion System to protect the EU values and exclude entities from receiving EU funds if they have engaged in activities contrary to the EU founding values4, such as incitement to discrimination, hatred or violence, where it concludes that their integrity is impacted and affects or risks affecting their performance of legal commitments undertaken5.

The Commission will continue rigorous monitoring procedures through checks and followups on compliance with EU values. The Commission will immediately act on any evidence, by implementing appropriate measures against unreliable entities, e.g. suspension of contract or payments, contract termination, recovery or exclusion from EU financing.
